items.heading: Week 1
items.text: Week 1: choose one target role. The portfolio gets sharper when it is built for a role family, not for everybody.

items.heading: Week 1 to 2
items.text: Week 1 to 2: create one audit project. This is usually the fastest route to visible judgment.

items.heading: Week 2 to 3
items.text: Week 2 to 3: create one simulation project. Pick a believable brief and solve it as if it came from a real client or employer.
